미가-3-1.title: 미가 3장 1절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-1.exegesis: 13. The breaker-- Jehovah-Messiah, who breaks through every obstacle in the way of their restoration: not as formerly breaking forth to destroy them for transgression ( Ex 19:22 ; Jud 21:15 ), but breaking a way for them through their enemies. they-- the returning Israelites and Jews. passed through the gate-- that is, through the gate of the foe's city in which they had been captives. So the image of the resurrection ( Ho 13:14 ) represents Israel's restoration. their king-- "the Breaker," peculiarly "their king" ( Ho 3:5 ; Mt 27:37 ). pass before them-- as He did when they went up out of Egypt ( Ex 13:21 ; De 1:30 , 33). the Lord on the head of them-- Jehovah at their head ( Is 52:12 ). Messiah, the second person, is meant (compare Ex 23:20 ; 33:14 ; Is 63:9 ).

미가-3-2.title: 미가 3장 2절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 3 Mi 3:1-12 . The Sins of the Princes, Prophets, and Priests: The Consequent Desolation of Zion. 1. princes-- magistrates or judges. Is it not for you?-- Is it not your special function ( Jr 5:4 , 5 )? judgment-- justice. Ye sit in judgment on others; surely then ye ought to know the judgment for injustice which awaits yourselves ( Ro 2:1 ).

미가-3-3.title: 미가 3장 3절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-3.exegesis: 2. pluck off their skin ... flesh-- rob their fellow countrymen of all their substance ( Psa 14:4 ; Pr 30:14 ).
미가-3-3.theologicalNote: 2. pluck off their skin ... flesh-- rob their fellow countrymen of all their substance ( Psa 14:4 ; Pr 30:14 ).

미가-3-4.title: 미가 3장 4절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-4.exegesis: 3. pot ... flesh within ... caldron-- manifold species of cruel oppressions. Compare Eze 24:3 , &c., containing, as to the coming punishment, the same figure as is here used of the sin: implying that the sin and punishment exactly correspond.

미가-3-5.title: 미가 3장 5절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-5.exegesis: 4. Then-- at the time of judgment, which Micah takes for granted, so certain is it (compare Mi 2:3 ). they cry ... but he will not hear-- just as those oppressed by them had formerly cried, and they would not hear. Their prayer shall be rejected, because it is the mere cry of nature for deliverance from pain, not that of repentance for deliverance from sin. ill in their doings-- Men cannot expect to do ill and fare well.

미가-3-6.title: 미가 3장 6절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-6.exegesis: 5. Here he attacks the false prophets, as before he had attacked the "princes." make my people err-- knowingly mislead My people by not denouncing their sins as incurring judgment. bite with ... teeth, and cry, Peace-- that is, who, so long as they are supplied with food, promise peace and prosperity in their prophecies. he that putteth not into their mouths, they ... prepare war against him-- Whenever they are not supplied with food, they foretell war and calamity. prepare war-- literally, "sanctify war," that is, proclaim it as a holy judgment of God because they are not fed (see on Jr 6:4 ; compare Is 13:3 ; Joe 1:14 ).

미가-3-7.title: 미가 3장 7절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-7.exegesis: 6. night ... dark-- Calamities shall press on you so overwhelming as to compel you to cease pretending to divine ( Zec 13:4 ). Darkness is often the image of calamity ( Is 8:22 ; Am 5:18 ; 8:9 ).

미가-3-8.title: 미가 3장 8절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-8.exegesis: 7. cover their lips-- The Orientals prided themselves on the moustache and beard ("upper lip," Margin). To cover it, therefore, was a token of shame and sorrow ( Le 13:45 ; Eze 24:17 , 22 ). "They shall be so ashamed of themselves as not to dare to open their mouths or boast of the name of prophet" [Calvin]. there is no answer of God-- They shall no more profess to have responses from God, being struck dumb with calamities ( Mi 3:6 ).

미가-3-9.title: 미가 3장 9절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-9.exegesis: 8. I-- in contrast to the false prophets ( Mi 3:5 , 7 ). full of power-- that which "the Spirit of Jehovah" imparts for the discharge of the prophetical function ( Lu 1:17 ; 24:49; Ac 1:8 ). judgment-- a sense of justice [Maurer]; as opposed to the false prophets' speaking to please men, not from a regard to truth. Or, "judgment" to discern between graver and lighter offenses, and to denounce punishments accordingly [Grotius]. might-- moral intrepidity in speaking the truth at all costs ( 2Ti 1:7 ). to declare unto Jacob his ... sin-- ( Is 58:1 ). Not to flatter the sinner as the false prophets do with promises of peace.

미가-3-10.title: 미가 3장 10절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-10.exegesis: 9. Hear-- resumed from Mi 3:1 . Here begins the leading subject of the prophecy: a demonstration of his assertion that he is "full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah" ( Mi 3:8 ).
미가-3-10.theologicalNote: 9. Hear-- resumed from Mi 3:1 . Here begins the leading subject of the prophecy: a demonstration of his assertion that he is "full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah" ( Mi 3:8 ).

미가-3-11.title: 미가 3장 11절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-11.exegesis: 10. They-- change of person from "ye" ( Mi 3:9 ); the third person puts them to a greater distance as estranged from Him. It is, literally, "Whosoever builds," singular. build up Zion with blood-- build on it stately mansions with wealth obtained by the condemnation and murder of the innocent ( Jr 22:13 ; Eze 22:27 ; Ha 2:12 ).

미가-3-12.title: 미가 3장 12절 역사문법적 주해
미가-3-12.exegesis: 11. heads thereof-- the princes of Jerusalem. judge for reward-- take bribes as judges ( Mi 7:3 ). priests teach for hire-- It was their duty to teach the law and to decide controversies gratuitously ( Le 10:11 ; De 17:11 ; Mal 2:7; compare Jr 6:13 ; Jude 11). prophets ... divine-- that is, false prophets. Is not the Lord among us?-- namely in the temple ( Is 48:2 ; Jr 7:4 , 8-11 ).
